subject: general
question: What is the theme for International Customs Day 2025?

options.text: Customs Engaging Traditional and New Partners with Purpose
Foster collaborative relationships with established trade partners
Embrace technological advancements by collaborating with new partners
Customs Delivering on its Commitment to Efficiency, Security, and Prosperity

solution:
The correct answer is __**Customs Delivering on its Commitment to Efficiency, Security, and Prosperity.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The theme for International Customs Day 2025 is Customs Delivering on its Commitment to Efficiency, Security, and Prosperity.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• ** **International Customs Day happens every year on January 26.
 
• In 1983, the World Customs Organization (WCO) initiated a tradition aimed at acknowledging the pivotal contribution of customs agencies in ensuring the efficiency of international trade.
 
• The theme for International Customs Day 2025 is **“**Customs Delivering on its Commitment to Efficiency, Security, and Prosperity**"**
 
• The idea of International Customs Day goes back to the formation of the **Customs Cooperation Council (C.C.C.)** in **1952**.
